svg.title: Per-stage action space closes the gap to the per-stage static baseline
svg.desc: Dumbbell charts for four workload and array cells. Left: the learned mapper's utilisation relative to the best per-stage static mapping; the original action space lost significantly in every cell and the per-stage action space is statistically level with it. Right: relative to the best single dataflow, the margin grows.
